title.narrative: Ethical Journalism for Sustainable Peace in Syria

description.narrative: Overall Objective: To contribute to fostering dialogue for peace and fulfilling the information needs of Syrians within a professional media landscape and to contribute to opinion formation and debate on a democratic and peaceful Syria.Specific Objective: To create a constructive environment for sustainable peace through strengthening media, enhancing dialogue, and by influencing the narrative in and on Syria.
